title: Quora Scraper
description: Scrape Quora questions, answers, and profiles. Paste Quora URLs — question, profile, space, or topic. The Actor auto-detects each URL's type and returns flat, structured records.

startUrls.title: Quora URLs
startUrls.description: List of Quora URLs to scrape. Each may be a question page (https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-way-to-learn-programming), a profile (https://www.quora.com/profile/Adam-DAngelo), a space (https://www.quora.com/q/<space>), or a topic (https://www.quora.com/topic/<topic>). The type is auto-detected from the URL. At least one URL is required.

maxItemsPerTarget.title: Max records per target
maxItemsPerTarget.description: Maximum number of records to return for each URL or keyword. The Actor scrolls to paginate until this cap, then stops, so it doubles as your cost ceiling (each record is one billable event). Defaults to 50. Lower it for cheaper test runs.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent browsers
maxConcurrency.description: How many target pages to scrape in parallel. Defaults to 5 (max 10). Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
